title: Two days out: Webb County heads into the final weekend before Election Day
excerpt: Webb County voters who did not vote early have two days left to get ready: Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, when polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Early
content:
Webb County voters who did not vote early have two days left to get ready: Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, when polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Early voting closed Friday, October 30, with 46,332 ballots cast — 45,483 in person and 849 by mail — and the final day alone produced 6,130 votes, the highest single-day turnout of the two-week period, according to KGNS, citing the Webb County Elections Administration.

On the ballot are the Laredo mayor's race, Laredo City Council Districts 1, 2, 3 and 6, Municipal Court Judge Place 1, the TX-28 U.S. House race, a U.S. Senate seat, and school board contests, among other races.

On Election Day, voters cast ballots at their assigned polling place — not at any early-voting site. Sites designated by the Webb County Commissioners Court on August 24, 2026, include City Hall of Laredo, 1110 Houston St.; Shirley Field Sports Complex, 2002 San Bernardo Ave.; St. Frances Cabrini Church, 3018 Davis Ave.; Hillside Recreation Center, 5700 McPherson Rd.; the Laredo Fire Department, 616 E. Del Mar Blvd.; and the Bruni Community Center, 303 E. 12th St. in Bruni. Voters should confirm their assigned site before heading out through the Texas Secretary of State's My Voter Portal at VoteTexas.gov.

Texas requires an approved form of photo identification to vote in person. Voters in line by 7 p.m. can still cast a ballot.

Mail-in ballots must reach the county early voting clerk by 7 p.m. on Election Day, or by 5 p.m. Wednesday, November 4, if postmarked by 7 p.m. on Election Day.

Questions about polling places or ballots can go to the Webb County Elections Office at (956) 523-4050.

What to watch

Early voting ran well ahead of the comparable 2022 pace, so the open question on Tuesday is whether Election Day turnout pushes Webb County to a midterm total it has not seen in years — and which local races the late-deciding voters break toward. Webb Watch 956 will follow the results as they come in.

Note: the City Council District 8 special election is separate. Its early voting runs November 23 through December 1, with Election Day Saturday, December 5 — it is not on the November 3 ballot.
